details.completeness_justification: All key information units are adequately represented in the candidate summary. K1 is covered by S2 (revenue growth) and S11 (net profit increase). K2 is covered by S9 (EBITDA decline) and S10 (exclusion of negative goodwill). K3 is covered by S15 (acquisition date and capabilities). K4 is covered by S15 (factory commencement) and S16 (production targets and export markets). K5 is covered by S5 (sales mix change) and S6-S8 (specific segment percentages and contributions). K6 is covered by S3 (Lithuania and other countries revenue) and S4 (EU revenue percentage shift). K7 is covered by S17 (debt increase). K8 is covered by S18 (operating cash flow negativity and funding sources implied). K9 is covered by S14 (milk purchase volume increase). No material omissions affect the overall understanding.

coherence_issues.description: While S6, S7, and S8 provide detailed breakdowns of revenue changes by product category, there is no explicit explanation of how these changes relate to the overall revenue growth mentioned in S1 and S2. The summary does not clarify whether the growth in some categories (e.g., dry milk, fresh milk, canned milk) fully offsets the decline in others (cheese, cheese products) to achieve the reported 22.4% overall revenue increase.

candidate_sentences.text: Cheese, cheese products and other sales declined 28.8% to EUR 37.64 million, representing 43% of revenue compared with 75% in Q1 2025.
Dry milk product revenue more than doubled, rising 126.9% to EUR 24.66 million, while fresh milk product revenue increased 73.4% to EUR 12.75 million.
Canned milk products contributed EUR 11.92 million following the acquisition of Marijampolės pieno konservai.

details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is generally coherent with no severe contradictions. The structure follows a logical flow from revenue to profitability, acquisitions, and balance sheet items. However, there is a notable logical gap in the explanation of revenue composition changes (S6, S7, S8) relative to the overall revenue growth stated in S1 and S2. While the summary provides percentages for each product category, it does not explicitly reconcile how these changes combine to produce the 22.4% overall revenue increase. This creates a minor gap in the logical chain. There are no self-contradictions, organizational issues, or unnecessary repetition. Arithmetic differences (e.g., segment vs. consolidated figures) are not contradictions because the candidate does not claim exhaustive additivity.
